# Dr Amara Ndlovu

Dr Amara Ndlovu is Associate Professor in the Department of Information Systems at
Southern Cape Institute of Technology.

Dr Amara Ndlovu's stated research interests are enterprise architecture, responsible AI
governance, and resilient digital transformation.

Dr Amara Ndlovu's 2025 publication, "Architecture Controls for Responsible AI Adoption",
examines governance mechanisms in complex organisations.

Dr Amara Ndlovu is not accepting new doctoral Candidates for the 2027 intake.
